execution.fallbacks: edge chunk65536->32768->8192, activation checkpoint then microbatch1 accumulation; reference32M->16M->8M->2M chunks, total photons unchanged; preserve all attempts

stops: primary reference or physical ownership invalidity, unresolved identity, irreparable F/S dependency defects. No GGX gate. Trained fidelity failures recorded after executing F/S evaluation and cost, not replaced by a new architecture.
composition: same unchanged WL56 scene/C/solver; only eligible learned checkpoint enters. Separate oracle/reference and model/reference, preserve historical blue floor. If none eligible report skipped.
